description: List sales invoices, filtered by status, customer, invoice number, sales order number or date range. Unleashed: GET /Invoices/{page}.

customerCode.description: Only invoices for this customer code.

invoiceNumber.description: Only the invoice with this number (overrides other filters).

modifiedSince.description: Only records created or modified since this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

orderNumber.description: Only invoices for this sales order number.

pageSize.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Unleashed default is 200.

name: unleashed_list_invoices
title: List sales invoices
